title: GPU pod fit checklist — EU/APAC capacity review (Jul 2025)
body:
Purpose:

This working doc captures the rack-level fit, power allocation, and cooling margin analysis for two planned GPU pod buys (EU-west-1 colo and APAC co-lo expansion) targeted for deployment in Q4 2025. The aim is to produce an actionable checklist for SRE/Facilities and a short remediation backlog for any racks that fail fit/margin thresholds.

Scope:
- Physical fit: RU, cage mounting, cable management space
- Electrical: PDU circuits, breaker sizing, per-rack continuous power (kW) and N+1 margin checks
- Thermal: inlet/exhaust delta, CRAC headroom, hot aisle containment interactions
- Logistics: shipment staging space, lift/cable runs, installation window constraints
- Targets: support sustained 300W/GPU (typical Ampere-class pod) with 20% headroom for continuous operation and 1.3 PUE assumed for colo calculations

Quick executive summary (TL;DR):
- EU-west colo (Site A): 12 racks scoped, 9 pass initial fit/power thresholds. 3 racks require PDU rebalancing or different PDUs (208V->415V step-up options) to meet continuous power budgets. Estimated remediation: 2 days of on-site tech + spare PDU hardware.
- APAC colo (Site B): 8 racks scoped, 6 pass but 2 racks show marginal inlet temps (exhaust recirculation from adjacent legacy kit). Requires rework of airflow baffles and temporary portable containment during install.
- Overall risk: medium. Main blockers are PDU port density and legacy CRAC placement at Site B. No site is immediately infeasible.

Rack summary table (observed values during site survey):

RACK | SITE | RU_AVAILABLE | INTENDED_PODS | EST_CONT_POWER_KW | PDU_PORTS_FREE | BREAKER_A | INLET_C | EXHAUST_C | NOTES
-----|------|--------------|----------------|-------------------|----------------|-----------|---------|----------|------
R1-02 | Site A | 42 | 4 | 9.6 | 2 | 60 | 20.5 | 34.2 | OK but PDU on 2nd PD unit, consolidate to free port for BMC PDUs
R1-07 | Site A | 48 | 4 | 9.6 | 0 | 60 | 21.1 | 35.0 | No free PDU ports -> requires new PDU or PDUs redistributed
R2-03 | Site A | 40 | 3 | 7.2 | 3 | 50 | 19.8 | 33.7 | Pass
R-B4 | Site B | 42 | 4 | 9.6 | 1 | 60 | 24.3 | 38.5 | High inlet (recirculation) — recommend temporary hooding + airflow survey
R-B5 | Site B | 44 | 4 | 9.6 | 2 | 60 | 22.0 | 36.7 | Pass with minor cable re-route
R-B8 | Site B | 48 | 5 | 12.0 | 0 | 100 | 24.8 | 39.2 | Has 100A breaker but PDU density insufficient. Needs custom PDU deploy

Notes on numbers and assumptions:
- EST_CONT_POWER_KW assumes 300W/GPU * GPUs per pod * pod count + 0.1 kW/rack for BMC/leaf switches and fans. Continuous power uses 0.8 of breaker rating as safe sustained load.
- INLET/EXHAUST temps are single-sensor averages collected during onsite survey under light load (simulated idle). Expect 2–4C increase under sustained loading; margin targets require inlet <= 23C at full load.
- PDU_PORTS_FREE counts individually addressable output ports compatible with C19/C13 as needed for target PDUs.

Checklist for go/no-go per rack (work item per rack):
- [ ] Confirm RU & cage clearance including front/rear service clearance (min 1.2m front).
- [ ] Validate PDU power path: vendor-supplied PDU model, port mapping, breaker id, and remote monitoring configured.
- [ ] Reserve spares: 1 spare PDU per 6 racks on arrival manifest.
- [ ] Confirm PDUs rated >= intended continuous kW with 20% headroom; if not, escalate to facilities for transformer step-up or alternate breaker.
- [ ] Run airflow smoke test and record inlet/exhaust thermals at 50% and 100% simulated load (use load generator schedule).
- [ ] Verify cable run lengths and dedicated cable trays; mark any >6m runs for custom power whip planning.
- [ ] Confirm lift/rigging window and staging area availability (document dock hours)

Remediation plan (high level):
- PDU redistribution: order 4x 42U PDUs with configurable bus bars (lead time 10d), spare stock from Site A to Site B as stop-gap.
- Airflow mitigation at Site B: temporary containment curtains + reposition CRAC ducts; schedule containment install 1 day before racking. Estimate vendor day-rate ~ $1,200/day.
- Temporary power: where breaker headroom insufficient, deploy portable 3-phase UPS racks for initial integration (cost estimate per rack: $2.5k, requires facilities approval).

Install phasing & run book outline:
Phase 0 (pre-stage) — 7 days before arrival:
- Hardware inventory & tag -> confirm PDUs + rails + patch kits
- Floor markings and cable tray reservation communicated to colo ops - Confirm lift windows and insurance docs

Phase 1 (racking + PDUs) — Day 0–2:
- Install rails, mount PDUs, light cable dressing (power only) - Validate remote PDU telemetry on first rack before continuing (if telemetry fails, stop further power connection)

Phase 2 (network + power commissioning) — Day 3:
- Power on leaf/BMC, run switch firmwares, connect fabrics, sanity checks - Ramp load to 50% using perf harness for thermal validation

Phase 3 (full load soak) — Day 4–5:
- 72-hour soak at expected continuous power, collect data (inlet/exhaust, PDU per-outlet currents, ambient CRAC temps) - If any inlet temp > 23C or >5C delta under soak, trigger rollback and address airflow remediation

Data capture template (fields to store into capacity tracking sheet):
- rack_id, site, pod_count, gpus_total, est_cont_kw, breaker_id, pdu_model, pdu_ports_used, inlet_c_50pct, inlet_c_100pct, exhaust_c_100pct, pdu_outlet_curves, notes

Open questions / decisions required:
1) Acceptable PUE assumption for colo billing: finance needs to confirm we can assume 1.25 vs conservative 1.35 for final chargeback. (Finance contact: Priya Patel)
2) Standard PDU spec: do we mandate 42U Switched PDUs with remote metering or allow mixed types? (Ops preference: uniform metered PDUs).
3) Containment: temporary vs permanent — budget approver required for permanent ducting at Site B.

Action items (owners):
- Marcus Lee: finalize PDU SKU list & order lead times by 2025-07-24
- Ava Kim: coordinate Site B containment vendor estimate and provisional booking by 2025-07-23
- Diego Martinez: update infra capacity tracker spreadsheet with rack-level fields and push for automation of inlet/exhaust logging by site sensors (JIRA-2031)
- Priya Patel: confirm PUE billing assumption with finance by 2025-07-21

Appendix A — quick cost estimates (ballpark):
- PDUs (42U switched, per unit): $2,400
- Portable UPS rack (temporary): $2,500 per rack install + cables
- Containment temporary install: $1,200/day vendor + $400 materials
- On-site technician day-rate: $1,000/day

Appendix B — photos & raw sensor logs:
Stored in shared drive folder: shared_drives/engineering/platform-engineering/site-surveys/2025-07 (see linked artifacts in header).

This doc is a working checklist intended for the install week. If items above change materially (PDU sku, breaker sizing, or cooling assumptions) update this doc and notify the team on #infra-deploy slack channel.
